_comment: Issue #46 canonical: [Invisibility]'s COMBAT read, live through real input. Loads near_invisibility_combat (mage L5, floodplains (30,16) facing down, met_relc ABSENT so goblin_encounter_1 fields no ally -- pc solo vs goblin_raider (melee)/goblin_shaman (ranged), giving the AI-exclusion proof its deterministic 'exactly one valid target' shape). Route mirrors combat_walkthrough's own real trigger of this same ambush (down4 -> (30,20), outside the Chebyshev-2 zone -- down1 crosses in and fires it for real). Kit order (known_skills: basic_cleaning, then mage L1/L2/L5 grants in level order) -> combat hotbar Attack(1)/Dash(2)/frost_bolt(3)/flame_jet(4)/invisibility(5)/End Turn (quick_cast/mana_shield stay ap_cost 0, no numbered slot; light is field-only). Proof, in order: (1) casting invisibility (hotbar_5) self-targets (skill_resolved target==pc), applies the invisible status with first_seen glossary text surfacing on the combat feed (status_applied.first_seen==true), same idiom status_first_encounter established for slowed; (2) ending the turn lets BOTH enemies act automatically (combat_playback's live AI-turn driving, not a QA-only mechanism) -- neither can target the sole player-side combatant while it's invisible, so zero attack_resolved/skill_resolved-at-pc fire before turn_started{pc} returns control; (3) pc's own Attack (hotbar_1) lands and immediately clears the status (status_expired{id:pc,status:invisible}) -- break-on-damage, live; (4) the very next enemy turn CAN target pc again (at least one attack_resolved/skill_resolved lands on pc) -- the exclusion was real, not a permanent immunity; (5) combat_autoplay finishes the fight to victory. rng_state: near_invisibility_combat's own seed-9 derivation, empirically verified live (see that fixture's _comment).

steps._comment: Move down to the 'Continue' row, confirm loads the near_invisibility_combat manual slot.
(30,16) -> (30,20): 4 open steps south, still outside goblin_encounter_1's Chebyshev-2 zone around (30,23) (dist 3).
One more step crosses into the trigger zone (dist 2) and fires the ambush for real -- no ally fields (met_relc absent), so pc is the SOLE player-side combatant.
quick_cast/mana_shield (ap_cost 0) and light (field-only) never occupy a numbered slot -- Attack/Dash/frost_bolt/flame_jet/invisibility/End Turn = 6.
(1) Cast [Invisibility] on self (hotbar_5) -- self-target plumbing (Tab/cycle no-op, confirm resolves target_id==pc), same as [Stealth]/[Second Wind].
steps.name: hotbar_5

steps._comment: The status surfaces on the combat feed/readout: status_applied carries first_seen + the L1-generated glossary text (wi_game.gd's _enrich_status_applied), same surface status_first_encounter proved for slowed.

(2) End turn: BOTH goblin_raider (melee) and goblin_shaman (ranged) get a turn, each with pc as their ONLY possible foe -- neither can pick an invisible sole target, so control returns to pc having attempted nothing at all.
steps.name: end_turn

steps._comment: (3) pc's own Attack (hotbar_1) breaks its own invisibility the instant it deals damage.
steps.name: hotbar_1

steps._comment: (4) End turn again: invisibility is gone, so the very next enemy turn CAN target pc for real -- the exclusion was temporary, not a permanent immunity.
steps.name: end_turn

steps._comment: (5) The invisibility proof is fully banked; finish the fight with plain autoplay.
